title: L2 — Pipeline Observability & Debug
description: Deep-debug dashboard. Select Domain → Pipeline to view runs. Click a Trace ID to load span waterfall, phase breakdown, root cause, and DQ events.

list.name: product
list.label: Data Product
list.description: Data product for SLO correlation. Pre-set when navigating from L1.

list.name: pipeline_id
list.label: Pipeline
list.description: Select a pipeline to see its runs and metrics.

list.name: trace_id
list.label: Trace ID (Run)
list.description: Paste or click a Trace ID to load the waterfall below.

list.name: portfolio
list.label: Portfolio
list.description: Context-only: portfolio passed from L1 via URL param.

options.content: ← Marketplace  ›  L1 Estate Health  ›  L2 Pipeline Debug  |  L3 Infrastructure →

panels.title: Success Rate (24h)
panels.description: 24h success rate for selected pipeline(s).

panels.title: Total Runs (24h)
panels.description: Total pipeline runs in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Failures (24h)
panels.description: Failed runs in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Last Run Duration
panels.description: Duration of the most recent completed run.

panels.title: SLA Breaches (24h)
panels.description: Runs that breached SLA threshold.

panels.title: Failure Rate (6h)
panels.description: 6h rolling failure rate.

panels.title: Run Rate — Success vs Failure
panels.description: Run throughput rate. Failures spike on intermittent or systematic issues.

panels.title: Pipeline Duration — per Run
panels.description: Last observed run duration per pipeline. Sustained growth = performance regression.

panels.title: PIPELINE RUNS — Click a Trace ID to drill into that run
Pipeline Runs
panels.description: All runs for selected pipeline(s) queried from Tempo. Click a Trace ID row to load the waterfall below.

targets.query: {span.pipeline.id=~"$pipeline_id" && span.deployment.environment="$environment" && name="pipeline.run"} | select(span.pipeline.name, span.pipeline.id, span.pipeline.status, span.pipeline.type, span.pipeline.failure_phase)

panels.title: TRACE DETAIL — ${trace_id}   ·   ↑ Select a run above to populate this section
Span Waterfall — Extract → Transform → Load
panels.description: Full trace waterfall for the selected run. Red spans = failed stage. Click any span bar to see attributes: row counts, operations, source/target, error message.

panels.title: Phase Spans — Duration & Status
panels.description: One row per ETL phase. ERROR status = this phase caused the failure.

panels.title: Root Cause Summary
panels.description: Spans with ERROR status. Empty = all phases succeeded.

panels.title: DATA QUALITY EVENTS — For Selected Run
DQ Events — Extract Phase
panels.description: DQ check events on the etl.extract span. Empty = no DQ events for this run.

panels.title: SLO Compliance
panels.description: Rolling SLO compliance for the associated data product.

panels.title: Health Score
panels.description: Composite health score for the data product.

panels.title: Error Rate
panels.description: Current error rate for the data product.

panels.title: Data Freshness
panels.description: Seconds since last successful data refresh.

panels.title: Error Budget %
panels.description: Percentage of 1% error budget remaining.

panels.title: Consumer Lag — Per Topic
panels.description: Kafka consumer lag per topic. Sustained high lag = processing bottleneck.

panels.title: Throughput — Msg/sec
panels.description: Message processing throughput per topic.

panels.title: End-to-End Latency — ms
panels.description: End-to-end processing latency from produce to consume.

panels.title: Pipeline Logs
panels.description: Loki logs filtered by pipeline. Set trace_id to narrow to a single run.

#### Quick Navigation
| Destination | Link |
|---|---|
| Data Marketplace Home | [Open](/d/marketplace-home?var-environment=${environment}) |
| L1 Estate Health | [Open](/d/watch-l1-estate?var-environment=${environment}&var-portfolio=${portfolio}&var-product=${product}) |
| L3 Infrastructure | [Open](/d/watch-l3-infra?var-environment=${environment}) |
| Trace Explorer (Tempo) | [Open in Explore](/explore?left=%7B%22datasource%22:%22tempo-dev%22%7D) |
